title: Seeds of Doubt
content:
Kiran's voice grew firmer with every word he spoke.

"I understood what she was trying to do."

"I warned you."

"Not just once..."

"But many times."

"I wanted to save you."

"But instead of listening to me..."

"You tried to convince me that she would never do anything wrong."

His disappointment was evident.

"I felt helpless."

"I wanted to help my friend..."

"But my friend refused to believe me."

He let out a deep sigh before continuing.

"After many days, Shreya finally came back to college."

"I thought she had stayed away because she was afraid I would question her."

"But when she returned..."

"She proposed to you."

"I realized why."

"She knew you trusted her blindly."

"She knew that if she confessed her love, you would always stand by her."

"So, she made sure you stayed on her side."

His words became even harsher.

"From that day onward..."

"She continued spending more and more time with Karthik."

"After your first meeting with the principal..."

"You slowly stopped talking to her."

"And that only made things easier for her."

"She acted as though she was heartbroken."

"She acted as though she was suffering."

"But from what I saw..."

"She was perfectly happy."

"She spent almost all her time with Karthik."

"They completed Intermediate together."

"And later..."

"They even joined the same engineering college."

Kiran paused for a brief moment.

"Then you started calling her again."

"She became irritated."

"She ignored your calls."

"She disconnected them."

"But when Rohini told you everything..."

"You became worried."

"So you contacted her again."

"And once again..."

"She came back."

"I couldn't help feeling that she had simply found another way to convince you."

"And you believed every word."

His voice softened.

"You trusted her too much, Siddu."

"From everything I had seen, it felt like she was playing with your emotions."

"After your first semester..."

"She disappeared from your life once again."

Silence filled the call.

I struggled to process everything Kiran had just told me.

One question still remained.

"Kiran..."

"How do you know all this?"

"I didn't see everything with my own eyes," he admitted.

"I pieced everything together from what our friends and Rohini told me."

I remained silent.

Then another name crossed my mind.

"What about Ruthika?"

"Who is she?"

Kiran answered without hesitation.

"Ruthika is Karthik's friend."

That was all he said.

Every word Kiran had spoken echoed inside my mind.

One part of me wanted to believe my best friend.

Another part refused to doubt the girl I had loved with all my heart.

For the first time, my heart and my mind stood on opposite sides.

My thoughts were in complete chaos.

After thanking Kiran for trying to help me, I quietly ended the call.

Even after the phone went silent...

The questions inside my mind only grew louder.
